core.title: Settings
core.intro: App-wide switches, appearance, logging, sound feedback, and config files.

enabled.title: VectorXR Enabled
enabled.description: Enables or disables all VectorXR OpenXR Enhancements at runtime.

language.title: Language
language.description: System (auto) follows the Windows display language. Stored on this PC only.
language.machineTranslated: This translation was made by machine and may read awkwardly. Corrections are welcome on GitHub.

tray.title: System Tray
tray.description: Closing this window keeps the app in the notification area, with health, the VectorXR switch, log level and Export Debug. Off: closing the window quits the app. Stored on this PC only.
tray.helperNote: The app and tray are a settings helper, not the OpenXR layer. VectorXR works in your games with them closed, while VectorXR Enabled is on.

inputDevices.title: Input Devices
inputDevices.description: For use in-game: looks again for a controller connected mid-session that VectorXR didn't detect.
inputDevices.noGame: No game is running with VectorXR.
inputDevices.asked_one: Asked {count} running game to look again.
inputDevices.asked_other: Asked {count} running games to look again.

trackSeenApps.title: Track discovered XR apps
trackSeenApps.description: Notes the executable name and first/last seen time of OpenXR apps you launch, so you can easily register them from the Application Registry. All data is kept locally on this PC.

logging.heading: Logging
logging.logLevelHelp: Info writes normal operational messages and errors. Debug adds verbose diagnostics, including bounded Turbo frame-timing traces. Logging changes apply live; launch the VR app with Debug enabled for runtime clock measurements.
logging.retentionHelp: Number of rotated log files to keep. Older files are removed after the retention count is exceeded.
logging.exportDebugHelp: Saves the logs, settings and diagnostics as one ZIP file to share, as on the Home tab.

sound.heading: Sound Feedback
sound.description: Master volume for the activate / deactivate cues you can attach to bindings.

configFiles.heading: Config Files
configFiles.description: Import another settings file, export the current settings, or confirm where VectorXR keeps its local config.

reset.title: Reset to defaults
reset.description: Rebuild settings.json with default values and clear local OpenXR application discovery data.
